receipt_families.expiry_rule: stale when base, candidate, policy, environment, lease, artifact, or workspace receipt changes

receipt_families.artifact_rule: promotion decision and exact accepted-point references only

receipt_families.expiry_rule: stale when candidate, evidence set, evaluator, reviewer identity/policy, accepted point, or evaluation receipt changes

receipt_families.artifact_rule: rollback operation and restored-point validation artifact references
receipt_families.expiry_rule: historical result remains about exact restoration; current-action use stales on accepted point, policy, integration, promotion, or artifact changes
